quantize_model_with_autoround: create an AutoRound instance with iters=0 to quantize an FP8 model using round-to-nearest
save_quantized_model_as_gguf: call quantize_and_save with format gguf:q4_0 to export a quantized model as GGUF
quantize_with_layer_config: pass a layer_config dict to AutoRound to quantize specific layers like lm_head at 4 bits
check_quantized_module_types: call check_and_mark_quantized_module on a model to detect and return FP8 weight types
convert_fp8_to_high_precision: call convert_module_to_hp_if_necessary to convert FP8Linear layers back to standard torch.nn.Linear
